purpose: Define query-result caching as an explicitly keyed, revision-aware derived projection that never becomes authoritative data or bypasses current governance.

owns: DWH Query Result Cache Boundary semantics

topics.name: DWH Query Result Cache Boundary
topics.purpose: Define query-result caching as an explicitly keyed, revision-aware derived projection that never becomes authoritative data or bypasses current governance.

semantics.key_rule: Cache key includes exact query/profile/parameter identity plus applicable source revision/snapshot/governance context.
semantics.identity_rule: Cache entry identity is distinct from query definition/execution/result-set/source data identities.
semantics.source_rule: Cached result retains source query and revision/snapshot provenance.
semantics.authority_rule: Cache hit does not bypass current applicable authorization/visibility checks.
semantics.classification_rule: Cached values retain source/output classification and redaction constraints.
semantics.source_truth_rule: Cache is never the canonical source of truth merely because it is faster/available.
semantics.materialize_rule: Persistent materialized views follow the separate materialization boundary, not ordinary result-cache semantics.

invariants.rule: Indexes, statistics, caches and optimizer plans may change execution strategy only; they never change canonical query semantics, data identity, ownership, classification or authorization.

hard_gates.condition: cached restricted data served under broader context

prose.summary: Define query-result caching as an explicitly keyed, revision-aware derived projection that never becomes authoritative data or bypasses current governance.
